## Checklist

- [ ] Keeps the nine design decisions; `node tools/frep-guard/check.mjs` passes
- [ ] Decision 8: no incumbent construction (offset passes, engagement held by curves or by
      step-by-step steering, morphed spirals, bridge moves between offset passes) as a method,
      fallback, baseline, flag or test, and none named as the design target. Trochoids and
      field spirals perform no element of the live claims decision 8 lists. Physics objectives
      (chip thickness as the load measure) pursued through the plan field are fine.
- [ ] Decision 9: loops over samples, cells, poses or pixels run on the GPU, or the reason
      they don't is given above (CPU work uses `rayon`, not a single thread)
- [ ] Generator change: passes the field-native test (or not a generator change)
- [ ] No code copied or translated from GPL, LGPL, AGPL or proprietary sources
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are named above with their license and why they're needed
